schema.description: Extend the video identified by video_id. An explicit video is required; the shared provider account cannot select a caller-specific recent video.

example.prompt: The camera keeps drifting forward down the alley.

callback_url.description: The callback notification address. Server will notify when the task status changes.

negative_prompt.description: Negative text prompt for elements to avoid in the extended video

prompt.description: Positive text prompt for guiding the video extension

video_id.description: The ID of the video to be extended. Supports videos generated by text-to-video, image-to-video, and previous video extension operations. Cannot exceed 3 minutes total duration after extension.

KlingVideoGenCfgScale.description: Flexibility in video generation. The higher the value, the lower the model's degree of flexibility, and the stronger the relevance to the user's prompt.
